title: Mazurka
identity: Pierre-Max Dubois's Mazurka, Hommage à Chopin, is an alto saxophone and piano work published by Leduc as AL23010. The Philharmonie de Paris's 10 ans avec le saxophone guide gives 3:10, dates it 1961, describes a Lento followed by Allegro vivo, and lists it as intended for seventh year in that guide's conservatory sequence.

evidence.claim: Philharmonie guide gives AL23010, 3:10, dates the piece 1961, describes Lento then Allegro vivo, and places it in seventh-year conservatory study.
evidence.source_name: Philharmonie de Paris, 10 ans avec le saxophone

evidence.claim: Copyright registration confirms title and alto saxophone/piano instrumentation, 1961 registration.

review_focus: Inference from the guide's documented tempo and placement: verify the transition from Lento into Allegro vivo and how the two sections are paced. No score notation inspected.
collection_flag: Published original saxophone/piano work; pedagogical guide addresses the printed saxophone part.
gaps: Guide entry was read, but notation and a performance recording were not inspected; no note-level demands are established.
